title: Q2 2024 Planning — Search Transition

content:

   - No approval decision made today.

title: ADR-009: Apple Sign-In — Final Decision
author: Priya Sharma
content:
ADR-009: Apple Sign-In for Auth Module

Status: REJECTED
Date: March 20, 2024
Decision makers: Priya Sharma, Legal Team

## Context
Apple Sign-In was proposed during the January 10, 2024 sprint planning for inclusion with OAuth2 Social Login.
It was NOT approved at that time and was held pending security review.

## Decision
Apple Sign-In is REJECTED.

## Reasons
1. Legal review identified App Store guideline compliance requirements that conflict with our current data handling policies.
2. Engineering effort estimate revised upward from 3 days to 3 weeks due to backend session handling complexity.
3. Insufficient user demand data to justify the effort at this time.

## Consequences
- Apple Sign-In will NOT be implemented in the foreseeable future.
- This decision may be revisited in 2025 if user demand data changes.

## Note
This ADR supersedes the 'pending security review' status from January 2024. Apple Sign-In was never implemented.
